general.name: Component Packaging Self-Test [Win]
general.description: Verifies that a .cpt built by tools/cpt.py imports into Datto RMM with its input variables intact. Reads its own variables back and prints a pass/fail report. Makes no change to the endpoint.

variables.name: TestString
variables.description: Arrives as arbitrary text. Leave the default to let the self-test pass.

variables.name: TestEmpty
variables.description: Declared with an empty default, to prove <defaultVal/> survives the round trip.

variables.name: TestBoolean
variables.description: Arrives as the literal text 'true' or 'false', never a real boolean.

variables.name: TestChoice
variables.description: A drop-down. The UI shows the name, the script receives the value.
